name: Sliver Wraith Seeker

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Hypnotic Form
traits.details: each enemy that ends its turn in the aura is slowed and takes a -2 penalty to Will until the end of its next turn.

auras.name: Hypnotic Form
auras.details: each enemy that ends its turn in the aura is slowed and takes a -2 penalty to Will until the end of its next turn.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is knocked prone and can’t stand up (save ends)
psychic damage and the seeker slides the target 5 squares to a square either adjacent to the seeker or within its hypnotic form aura
